---
title: Code block style, no fill on the skylighting path
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template sets `fill: none` in `quarto-code-block-style`.
The code block must have no background, so no block is drawn with the default fill.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update(s => s + (fill: none))
#show block.where(fill: luma(230)): it => { counter("cbs-default-native").step(); it }
#show block.where(fill: rgb("#f1f3f5")): it => { counter("cbs-default-skylighting").step(); it }
#show block.where(stroke: 0.5pt + luma(128)): it => { if it.fill == none { counter("cbs-none").step() }; it }
```

```python
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context {
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-default-native").final().first(), 0, message: "a code block kept the native default fill")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-default-skylighting").final().first(), 0, message: "a code block kept the highlight style fill")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-none").final().first(), 1, message: "expected 1 code block with no fill")
}
```
